critique_summary: The platform is experiencing a catastrophic failure state with 5 critical core degradations (8/8 jobs failing) within a 45-minute window. Data integrity is compromised as evidenced by out-of-bounds conviction scores (5.0) and a total mismatch between trade logs and performance summaries reporting zero activity.
critique_flags: Critical system degradation: 8/8 scheduler jobs failed 5x in 24 hours
Conviction score anomaly: Values recorded at 5.00 (expected range 0-1)
Wash-sale blindness: Repeated loss-to-win sequences in AVAXUSD and ETHUSD within 24 hours
Data reporting mismatch: Performance summary reports 0 trades while log shows 28+ executions
Stale equity curve: No updates recorded between 19:17 and 01:53
